summary.text: Donovan Fenton is a Democratic state senator who has represented New Hampshire Senate District 10 since December 2022 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives from 2016 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Donovan Fenton was born and lives in Keene, New Hampshire, and earned a B.A. in social sciences from Towson University and an M.A. in political management from George Washington University in 2015.
He has served on the boards of The Community Kitchen of Keene and the Cedarcrest Center for Children with Disabilities.
Fenton represented Cheshire 8 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives from 2016 to 2022.
He succeeded Jay Kahn (D) in the Senate and assumed office on December 7, 2022.
For 2025-2026, he was assigned to the Capital Budget, Commerce, Transportation, and Ways and Means committees.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026.
